unresolved access to truth, justice, and integral reparations, and identification of two of the 43 students.","Attribution is institutional and does not establish personal presidential direction."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the date, category-5 intensification, CNDH deployment and inspections, coordination, monitored activities, and return of 70 million pesos to SHCP.","The actions are attributed to the CNDH, not personally to the president."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the staffing process, nine research lines, 20 works, 160 activities, 284 participants, more than 10,685 attendees, and more than 500 participating institutions.","The excerpt reports institutional activity and does not establish presidential direction."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the child-protection mechanism, the migration dialogue involving more than 54 specialists, the planned working group, and construction of a progressivity-indicator system.","It records agreements and intended follow-up, not verified downstream implementation."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the May 2023 GANHRI A-status accreditation, SECRIDH monitoring system, 23 urgent actions, 12 precautionary measures, and coordination with authorities and civil-society organizations.","The excerpt does not establish personal presidential compliance or obstruction."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports quarterly target monitoring, evaluations, indicator revisions, creation of the DMSCI on 16 October 2023, the open observatory, and use of geospatial and open-source information to monitor rights and vulnerable groups.","These are CNDH institutional actions, not demonstrated national policy outcomes."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The CNDH reported restructuring, austerity, and resource reallocation: 93% of its approved 2023 budget was exercised, 69% of spending went to protection activities compared with 54% in 2019, official-event spending fell by up to 80%, public procurement was emphasized, and direct-award or three-bid procedures accounted for 4.61% of the authorized budget.","notes":["The excerpt supports the budget, spending, procurement, and austerity claims.","The excerpt does not support the claimed suppression of 191 positions or reduction of authorized staff from 1,885 to 1,700, so those claims were removed.","The reported decisions are attributed to the CNDH, not personally to the president."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the courses, participation counts, service-career evaluations, 12 deputy-visitor convocatorias, and pilot opposition-based competition for director positions.","The excerpt describes intended transparency and exclusion of favoritism, not proof that all appointments were ultimately independent or effective."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the autonomous OIC, 41 audits, 160 pending observations, 84 resolved observations, 793 investigation files, 267 administrative-responsibility proceedings, 53 findings of responsibility, and referral of serious cases to the Federal Administrative Justice Tribunal.","The excerpt also states that 62 observations remained pending and does not establish overall sanction effectiveness."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-R02-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The CNDH transparency unit handled 1,989 information and data-access requests in 2023. Of 58 review appeals, the transparency institute modified 23 responses, issued seven sobreseimientos, confirmed 16, and revoked seven; the CNDH also updated transparency portals, trained 470 staff, and published public versions of 2,543 historical recommendations.","notes":["The excerpt supports all listed quantities and activities.","The summary's term \"dismissed\" was narrowed to \"issued seven sobreseimientos,\" matching the excerpt's wording.","The evidence concerns the CNDH and the transparency institute, not a presidential disclosure decision."]}]}
